templates.template: Proxmox Datacenter Manager remotes by HTTP
templates.name: Proxmox Datacenter Manager remotes by HTTP
templates.description: Monitors the PVE clusters and PBS servers managed by Proxmox Datacenter Manager through a single authenticated HTTPS GET to /resources/list, so Zabbix needs no access to the hypervisors or backup servers themselves. Discovers remotes (reachability and error), PVE nodes (status, CPU, memory, uptime), VMs and containers (status, CPU, memory, container disk, uptime), PVE storage (status, usage) and PBS nodes and datastores (CPU, memory, usage, maintenance). Zabbix 7.0+. Set {$PDM.URL}, {$PDM.TOKEN.ID} and {$PDM.TOKEN.SECRET}; grant Auditor to both user and token on /resource. Can be linked to the same host as "Proxmox Datacenter Manager self by HTTP". TLS certificate verification (peer and host) is disabled by default so the self-signed certificate PDM ships with works out of the box; to enforce it, set "SSL verify peer" and "SSL verify host" on "PDM: Get remote resources" after installing the PDM CA on the Zabbix server/proxy. Data is as fresh as PDM's cache ({$PDM.RES.MAXAGE} seconds). Not covered: backup job results, replication, Ceph health, disk SMART, guest disk usage for VMs and per-guest I/O. Licensed under GPLv3.

items.name: PDM: Get remote resources
items.description: GET only. One request returns every PVE node, guest and storage and every PBS node and datastore of all remotes the token may audit, as cached by PDM (at most {$PDM.RES.MAXAGE} seconds old). Headers and body are both retrieved so the dependent "Remote resources payload" item can tell 401/403/404/5xx apart from transport failures, which are replaced by the marker TRANSPORT-ERROR.

items.name: PDM: Remote resources payload
items.description: Normalized resources response: summary counters, one object per remote, PVE node, guest, storage, PBS node and datastore keyed by "<remote>/<name>", plus the discovery lists. {"http":<code>,"error":"<reason>"} on failure. All other items hang off this item.

items.name: PDM: Resources HTTP code
items.description: HTTP status of the resources request. 200 = OK, 401 = bad token, 403 = missing Auditor ACL on /resource, 404 = wrong URL/version, 0 = no HTTP response (DNS, TLS, timeout, refused).

triggers.name: PDM: Resources request failed (HTTP {ITEM.LASTVALUE1}, 0 = no response)
triggers.expression: last(/Proxmox Datacenter Manager remotes by HTTP/pdm.res.http.code)<>200 and count(/Proxmox Datacenter Manager remotes by HTTP/pdm.res.http.code,{$PDM.RES.FAIL.WINDOW},"eq",200)=0
triggers.description: The resources request has not returned HTTP 200 for the whole window, so no remote, node, guest or storage is being monitored. See item "PDM: Resources request result": 0 = DNS/TLS/timeout/refused (raise {$PDM.RES.TIMEOUT} if many remotes are slow), 401 = token ID/secret, 403 = Auditor ACL on /resource for both user and token, 404 = URL/PDM version.

triggers.name: PDM: No resources samples
triggers.description: Zabbix received no result at all from the resources item (item disabled, proxy down, or {$PDM.RES.NODATA} shorter than {$PDM.RES.INTERVAL}).

items.name: PDM: Resources request result
items.description: OK, or the reason the resources request failed. Only changes (plus a daily heartbeat) are stored.

items.name: PDM: Remotes unreachable
items.description: Remotes for which PDM returned an error; see the per-remote items for the reason.

items.name: PDM: PVE nodes offline or unknown
PDM: PVE storages available
items.description: Shared storage is counted once per remote.

items.name: PDM: PVE storages unavailable
items.description: Shared storage is counted once per remote.

items.name: PDM: PVE CPU utilization
items.description: Weighted by core count over all online PVE nodes.

items.name: PDM: PVE memory used
items.description: Sum over all online PVE nodes.

items.name: PDM: PVE memory total
items.description: Sum over all online PVE nodes.

items.name: PDM: PVE storage used
items.description: Available storages only; shared storage is counted once per remote.

items.name: PDM: PVE storage total
items.description: Available storages only; shared storage is counted once per remote.

discovery_rules.name: Remote discovery
discovery_rules.description: One entry per PDM remote (PVE cluster or PBS server).

item_prototypes.name: Remote {#REMOTE}: Reachable
item_prototypes.description: 1 = PDM fetched the resources of this remote without error.

trigger_prototypes.name: Remote {#REMOTE}: Unreachable from PDM
trigger_prototypes.description: PDM could not query this remote for the whole window, so its nodes, guests and storage are not updated. See item "Remote {#REMOTE}: Last error".

item_prototypes.name: Remote {#REMOTE}: Last error
item_prototypes.description: OK, or the error PDM got when querying this remote. Only changes (plus a daily heartbeat) are stored.

discovery_rules.name: PVE node discovery
discovery_rules.description: PVE cluster nodes of all PVE remotes. Metrics are only collected while the node is online.

trigger_prototypes.name: Node {#REMOTE}/{#NODE}: Not online
trigger_prototypes.expression: last(/Proxmox Datacenter Manager remotes by HTTP/pdm.node.status[{#KEY}])<>1 and count(/Proxmox Datacenter Manager remotes by HTTP/pdm.node.status[{#KEY}],{$PDM.NODE.FAIL.WINDOW},"eq",1)=0
trigger_prototypes.description: The PVE cluster has not reported this node as online for the whole window.

discovery_rules.name: PVE guest discovery
discovery_rules.description: QEMU VMs and LXC containers of all PVE remotes; templates are skipped. Keyed by remote and VMID, so migration between nodes keeps history. Metrics are only collected while running.

trigger_prototypes.name: Guest {#NAME} ({#KEY}): Stopped
trigger_prototypes.expression: last(/Proxmox Datacenter Manager remotes by HTTP/pdm.guest.status[{#KEY}])=0 and count(/Proxmox Datacenter Manager remotes by HTTP/pdm.guest.status[{#KEY}],{$PDM.GUEST.STOP.WINDOW},"eq",1)>0 and {$PDM.GUEST.STOP.ALERT:"{#KEY}"}=1
trigger_prototypes.recovery_expression: last(/Proxmox Datacenter Manager remotes by HTTP/pdm.guest.status[{#KEY}])=1
trigger_prototypes.description: The guest was running within the last {$PDM.GUEST.STOP.WINDOW} and is now stopped. Guests that are already stopped when discovered do not alert. Stays open until the guest runs again; close manually after an intentional shutdown, or set {$PDM.GUEST.STOP.ALERT:"{#KEY}"} to 0. A guest on an offline node has state unknown and does not alert here.

item_prototypes.name: Guest {#NAME} ({#KEY}): Node
item_prototypes.description: PVE node the guest is placed on. Only changes (plus a daily heartbeat) are stored.

item_prototypes.name: Guest {#NAME} ({#KEY}): CPU utilization
item_prototypes.description: Percent of the guest's own vCPUs. Collected only while running.

item_prototypes.name: Guest {#NAME} ({#KEY}): Memory used percent
item_prototypes.description: For VMs without the balloon driver this includes the guest page cache, so no trigger is defined.

item_prototypes.name: Guest {#NAME} ({#KEY}): Disk used percent
item_prototypes.description: Root filesystem of the container. Not created for VMs, which report no disk usage without a guest agent.

discovery_rules.name: PVE storage discovery
discovery_rules.description: PVE storages. Shared storage is one entry per remote ({#NODE} = shared, key <remote>/<storage>); local storage is one entry per node (key <remote>/<node>/<storage>).

trigger_prototypes.name: Storage {#STORAGE} ({#REMOTE}, {#NODE}): Not available
trigger_prototypes.expression: last(/Proxmox Datacenter Manager remotes by HTTP/pdm.storage.status[{#KEY}])<>1 and count(/Proxmox Datacenter Manager remotes by HTTP/pdm.storage.status[{#KEY}],{$PDM.STORAGE.FAIL.WINDOW},"eq",1)=0
trigger_prototypes.description: PVE has not reported this storage as available for the whole window. Shared storage only alerts when no node sees it as available.

trigger_prototypes.name: Datastore {#REMOTE}/{#DATASTORE}: Usage above {$PDM.DATASTORE.PUSED.CRIT:"{#KEY}"}%
trigger_prototypes.description: Backups will fail once the datastore is full; run prune and garbage collection or extend the datastore.

trigger_prototypes.name: Datastore {#REMOTE}/{#DATASTORE}: In maintenance mode
trigger_prototypes.expression: last(/Proxmox Datacenter Manager remotes by HTTP/pdm.datastore.maintenance[{#KEY}])=1
trigger_prototypes.description: The datastore is read-only or offline for maintenance; backups to it will fail.

macros.description: PDM base HTTPS URL, without a trailing slash or /api2/json. Same macro as the self template, so both can be linked to one host.
PDM API token ID; both user and token need Auditor on /resource (and on /system/status for the self template).
PDM API token secret.
Poll interval for the resources request.
Seconds PDM may serve cached remote data before querying the remotes again.
Timeout of the resources request. PDM waits for the slowest remote, so keep it above its remote connect timeout.
Resources request must fail for this whole window before alerting.
Alert when no resources result arrives for this long. Keep it above {$PDM.RES.INTERVAL}.
Discovery data is only processed when it changes, or at least this often.
Only discover remotes whose name matches this regex.
Skip remotes whose name matches this regex.
Only discover guests whose name matches this regex.
Skip guests whose name matches this regex.
Only discover PVE storages whose ID matches this regex.
Skip PVE storages whose ID matches this regex.
A remote must be unreachable for this whole window before alerting.
A PVE node must be not online for this whole window before alerting.
A PVE storage must be unavailable for this whole window before alerting.
Seconds of uptime below which "Recently restarted" is raised for PVE and PBS nodes.
PVE node CPU warning percent, sustained 5m. Context: <remote>/<node>.
PVE node memory warning percent, sustained 5m. Context: <remote>/<node>.
A guest that was running within this window and is now stopped raises "Stopped".
Set to 0 to silence "Stopped". Context: <remote>/<vmid>, e.g. {$PDM.GUEST.STOP.ALERT:"cluster1/105"}.
Container root disk warning percent, sustained 5m. Context: <remote>/<vmid>.
PVE storage warning percent, sustained 5m. Context: <remote>/<storage> (shared) or <remote>/<node>/<storage> (local).
PVE storage critical percent, sustained 5m. Same context as the warning macro.
PBS CPU warning percent, sustained 5m. Context: <remote>/<node>.
PBS memory warning percent, sustained 5m. Context: <remote>/<node>.
PBS datastore warning percent, sustained 5m. Context: <remote>/<datastore>.
PBS datastore critical percent, sustained 5m. Context: <remote>/<datastore>.
